Flypage now fits on small screens, such as 1366×768 laptops.

## Changes

- On a screen less than 900 pixels tall, the processing window opens at a size that fits the screen. Thumbnails, destination icons and margins are smaller, so the files, the folders and the bottom toolbar are all visible without resizing the window. Larger screens are unchanged.

## Install (Debian 13 "trixie" or later)

```sh
sudo apt install ./flypage_0.1.2_all.deb
```

When upgrading from 0.1.1, the same command replaces the installed version.

To check the download: `sha256sum -c flypage_0.1.2_all.deb.sha256`
